title: Tough Physical Double‐Network Hydrogels Based on Amphiphilic Triblock Copolymers

extraction_issues.quote: the inter-domain distance changes as 1 - dB-DN gel/dB gel = 0.11
extraction_issues.reason: 表达式'1 - dB-DN gel/dB gel'疑似缺少下标或格式损坏，但数值0.11清晰，不影响理解。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: The amphiphilic tri-block copolymer consists of the hydrophobic end-blocks of poly(butyl methacrylate) (PBMA) and hydrophilic mid-block of poly(methacrylic acid) (PMAA), PBMA-b-PMAA-b-PBMA, with the weight-average degree of polymerization of 134-273129.
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 原文'134-273129'疑似为'134-273-129'的抽取拼接缺漏，后面实验部分明确给出134、273、129三个聚合度。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: Figure 4a shows the self-resilient behavior at a strain of 100% for different waiting times between successive loading-unloading tests.
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: 第10页开头语句'Figure 4a shows...'紧接第9页末尾的'...rupture of the covalent bonds of'，但第9页该句语义完整，第10页为新段落开始，似乎无中断。存疑。

self_check: 已核对关键数值：q1=0.201 nm⁻¹对应d=31.2 nm，f=33；B-DN3的q=0.224 nm⁻¹对应d=28.0 nm，体积收缩比0.60，理论距变0.16 vs 实测0.11；松弛时间约10⁵ s、4.1×10⁴ s、5×10⁻² s；Ea约260、254、180、179 kJ/mol；B gel力学：模量0.051±0.04 MPa，断裂应力0.19±0.04 MPa，应变0.97±0.2，断裂能63±7 J/m²；B-DN3：模量2.2±0.2 MPa，断裂应力10.5±1.4 MPa，应变5.7±0.7，撕裂能2850±220 J/m²；愈合应力2.3 MPa；水含量42%、82-83%、45-60%；聚合度134-273-129。公式和单位均按原文录入。仍有不确定处：原文提取文本中'134-273129'疑为笔误，已在extraction_issues标注。文中引用文献编号和图表具体数据（如SAXS拟合参数、FTIR峰位）均已保留，未擅自补充额外数值。
